channel.title: Japan AI Monitor
channel.description: AI monitoring of Japan's political, economic and security developments

item.title: Blackstone said to plan $1.9 billion central Tokyo office sale
item.description: The New York-based alternative asset manager is negotiating with a potential buyer, according to sources.

item.title: Japanese police arrest 6 men over scam from Vietnam
item.description: The Japanese suspects allegedly conspired to defraud a woman in her 20s in Yamaguchi Prefecture of ¥1 million earlier this year.

item.title: Daiwa profit climbs on strong global markets trading income
item.description: Net income climbed 7.8% from a year earlier to ¥51.43 billion in the three months ended Sept. 30, the Tokyo-based company said Friday.

item.title: Japanese researchers discover protein that may shed light on fertility decline
item.description: The findings could give insight into why older people face higher risks of infertility, miscarriage and their children having chromosomal disorders.

item.title: Swiss franc, Japanese yen Rise as DeepSeek News Boosts Safe Havens
item.description: The Yen and Swiss Franc were stronger against the dollar as investors sought safe havens after Chinese start-up DeepSeek’s new AI model hit U.S. tech stocks.
